title: Bind shell TLAS in mesh pass and add instrumentation
purpose: Ensure the shell TLAS is actually bound to the mesh shader path and verify at runtime.

steps.detail: Add binding_4 (VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_KHR) to mesh descriptor set layout with PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_BIT_KHR enabled.

In MeshParticleRenderer::render(), push both binding_3 (external TLAS) and binding_4 (shell TLAS) when available. Log both AS device addresses per frame for the first 3 frames and every 120 frames thereafter.
In shaders/particle_mesh.frag, assert via debug printf-style integer encoding (e.g., color bands) when binding_4 device address equals zero or when ray query returns 'no instance' frequently.
Add runtime toggle 'rtSelfShadow' and per-pass print that shows the toggle state and whether AS=0 or non-zero was bound.

acceptance: Logs show: 'Pushed 3 descriptors: particle_buffer external_TLAS shell_TLAS'
Non-zero device address printed for shell TLAS at render-time
No shader path trying to use binding_4 when rtSelfShadow=false
notes: Push descriptors are ephemeral; ensure push order matches layout bindings. Include robust logs to avoid silent non-binding.
